gradle/gradle#30052 (by jhonnen): FileCollection with Provider of relative paths broken after Configuration Cache serialization
### Current Behavior

A FileCollection containing a Provider of relative paths does not retain the root directory during Configuration Cache serialization:

```
// in subproject/build.gradle.kts:
val demoTask by tasks.registering {
    val files = project.files(provider { "someFile.txt" })

    println("config phase:")
    files.forEach { println(it) }
    doLast {
        println("execution phase:")
        files.forEach { println(it) }
    }
}
```

With enabled Configuration Cache, executing the task prints

```
config phase:
[...]\FileCollection-Provider-repro\subproject\someFile.txt

> Task :subproject:demoTask
execution phase:
[...]\FileCollection-Provider-repro\someFile.txt
```



### Expected Behavior

The contents of the FileCollection are the same during the execution phase, i.e. the files are still relative to the respective subproject, not to the root project.
